answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow secures the agent economy against Sybil attacks. First, every agent must deposit $50,000 into a locked vault. Second, peer nodes monitor every transaction for a signal of malicious behavior. Third, if fraud is detected, the escrowed funds are instantly burned. An attacker must risk $500,000 in collateral and 30 days of reputation loss to attempt one exploit. Trying to forge identities is like hacking through dense timber just to find a single opal; the effort is far too high for the reward. This makes deception economically impossible.
